description: Agree to a deal (NEGOTIATING -> DEAL_AGREED). Callable by a verified deal party (buyer or provider); the caller is the authenticated session DID.

deal_id.description: the deal id to agree (NEGOTIATING -> DEAL_AGREED); caller must be a deal party (buyer or provider)

idempotency_key.description: caller idempotency key; replays are no-ops

signed_artifact.description: base64-std of the complete dual-signed deal-artifact JSON (both party signatures over the JCS-canonical content). The bridge fail-closed-verifies both signatures + content-binding + freshness before firing escrow's AgreeDeal (SYSTEM_SPEC SM-3)

name: agree_deal
